The main takeaway from our work is that
the study of black shales and marl–shales alternations in the Maiolica Formation provides a useful tool for understanding local and global events in the Berrias–Aptian of the Tethy.

the Maiolica Formation is a good record of global and local events in the Tethyan domain, which is a key to understanding the evolution of the Tectonic and biogeochemical cycles in the Early Cretaceous.
, even though the Maiolica Formation has been extensively studied in the past, its sedimentology and organic geochemistry are still far from being fully understood.
